visualCharacteristics.purpose: Stacked list of resources, each a type icon and a linked title
visualCharacteristics.description: Single-column stacked list without borders or photos. Each item: a small resource-type icon (video, PDF, document) followed by one bold linked title. Paginated 5 per page with a numbered pager when there are more items (pager disabled in Universal Editor).

contentPattern.structure: type cell (video | pdf | document, or an icon image) | link cell (linked title)

reuseGuidance: Use for lists of linked resources (application notes, videos, PDFs) where each entry is just a type icon and a title. Use cards-grid for image cards with descriptions.
